alate: 有翅成虫的单眼较发达，其短径与单眼至触角窝的距离大体相当，二者近于等长。复眼位置偏低，复眼下缘至头壳下缘的间距等于复眼直径，或略小于该直径。上颚轮廓近方形，左右两颚各生二枚缘齿。
book_name: 长额堆砂白蚊 Cryptotermes dudleyi
distribution: 国内记录于广东徐闻与海南崖县、三亚、隆水、福山、澄迈；国外广布于菲律宾、马来西亚、印度尼西亚、印度、斯里兰卡、巴布亚新几内亚、非洲、澳大利亚、加勒比海沿岸、中美与南美。
en: Only the alate is treated here. The ocelli are relatively large, their short diameter nearly matching the distance from ocellus to antennal socket, while the eye lies low, its lower edge to the underside of the head equalling or slightly less than the eye diameter. Both mandibles are roughly square in outline and carry two marginal teeth each. The species ranges widely from southern China through Southeast Asia to Africa, Australia and the Americas.
